label: VERIFIED
extraction: Veritas Kanban SOP for Multi-Agent Orchestration (PM + Workers). Squad Chat Protocol: all agents must post to squad chat (glass box transparency). PM responsibilities: before spawning each worker, log spawn event with model; when worker fails, log failure; coordination updates as regular messages. Worker responsibilities: post progress throughout work including model identifier. Scripts: squad-event.sh for spawn/fail events, squad-post.sh for progress updates. --model flag shows which AI model behind each agent in squad chat UI. Example: Opus PM orchestrating Codex workers - Opus reads sprint tasks, assigns to self and Codex, spawns Codex worker with managed-run handoff template.
transfer_harness_fact: matches harness but specific transfer path not established
